latest_release.body:
0.17.0 release
### Standalone
- Native audio and MIDI on all three platforms: CoreAudio/CoreMIDI, WASAPI/WinMM, PipeWire/JACK/ALSA sequencer. RtAudio/RtMidi are still available behind a CMake switch (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/601, https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/599, https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/597, https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/596). This switch might be removed in future versions.
- New audio/MIDI settings screen: device, sample rate, buffer size, per-note-port MIDI selection and virtual ports. Microphones are opened only when chosen.
- Draft `clapwrapper/standalone_features.h` lets a plugin drive and read back that setup (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/590). It is now draft/5; draft/4 is no longer answered.
- A plugin can decide whether its state outlives a session: restored at the next launch, or every launch started fresh. The standalone keeps that choice with its audio/MIDI settings and offers it in its own menus: File > Restore Last Session on macOS, the window menu on Windows, a checkbox in the strip on Linux (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/604).
- New factory `clap_wrapper_plugin_factory_standalone_settings`: a plugin's entry can name the default for that choice and the base folder the standalone keeps its settings under (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/604).
- The standalone's settings are read before the plugin's `init()`, so changes made from `init()` are saved over the user's setup, not over an empty one (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/604).
- Reset State in the macOS File menu, as on Windows (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/603).
- On Linux the strip above the plugin is a CMake option, `CLAP_WRAPPER_STANDALONE_X11_HIDE_STRIP`, on by default: the window is the plugin's own size. A plugin without a gui keeps the strip (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/605).
- Shared settings envelope and persistence.
- Windows startup/shutdown lifetimes, UTF-16/UTF-8 conversion and combo bounds.
- Sample rate validated and persisted; no activation at rate 0 (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/589).
- Zeroed `clap_process` with a steady_time (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/587).

### AUv2
- Stability and thread-safety pass (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/536).
- Alternate bus layouts via configurable-audio-ports (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/539).
- Parameters flushed from the idle tick while the host is not rendering (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/issues/551, https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/556).
- `request_restart` (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/524) and `request_process`.
- Bypass parameter kept in step with `kAudioUnitProperty_BypassEffect` (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/570).
- `mark_dirty` announces PresentPreset, so Logic notices (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/578).
- Off-thread `request_resize` marshalled to the main thread (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/577).
- The Cocoa view is initialized before `gui->create()` (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/594).
- `get_resize_hints` is optional: the hints are initialized and its return value respected before the autoresizing mask is built (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/598).
- Component type taken from the host, not the build.

### VST3
- Surround and ambisonic speaker layouts carried in both directions, with a new `detail/vst3/channelmap` (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/593).
- Wrapper-owned parameter ids never reach the plugin (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/562).
- `maxSamplesPerBlock` treated as a maximum (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/567).
- Context-menu bridge (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper/pull/542).
- State-resto
